rfam.comment: Glutamine-II riboswich also known as downstream-peptide was first reported in a metagenomic analysis of conserved ncRNAs [1] The structure of Glutamine-II riboswitch has been reported in PDB:6QN3 [2] The structure comprises three coaxial helical domains, the central one of which is a pseudoknot (PK). The major groove of the PK provides the binding site for L-glutamine
